subject: Kafka Connect: Preserve explicit null values instead of replacing them with schema defaults (#17653)
body:
Struct.get() substitutes the schema default value when the stored value
is null, which silently turns an explicit null into the default. The
bundled SMTs now copy fields with getWithoutDefault, and the sink's own
reads (RecordConverter, including the variant conversion path, and
route-field extraction) are gated by a new option,
iceberg.tables.replace-null-with-default (default true, which preserves
the current behavior).

Closes #17652

Locks in that the null-gated schema walk emits no events when the table
schema matches, and the same events as the default-substitution path
when the record schema has drifted.

Renames fieldValue to fieldValueFromStruct to match RecordUtils, caches
replace-null-with-default in the constructor, and logs a warning when an
explicit null lands on a required column.

Leads with the option semantics, documents the required-column failure
mode and schema-force-optional mitigation, notes the JSON converter's
own replace.null.with.default (default true since Kafka 3.5.0), and
states that the bundled SMTs always preserve explicit nulls.

subject: GCP: Support CMEK (kms-key-name) for GCS server-side encryption (#18151)
body:
GCSOutputStream previously supported only CSEK (gcs.encryption-key), where
the raw key is sent to GCS on every request. This adds CMEK support via a
new gcs.kms-key-name property: the caller passes only the Cloud KMS key
resource name, and GCS performs encryption/decryption server-side, so the
caller's credentials need no KMS permission.

The write path emits BlobWriteOption.kmsKeyName(...) when the property is
set; reads require no change since CMEK decryption is automatic. CSEK and
CMEK are mutually exclusive (GCS rejects both on one object), enforced at
property-parse time with a fail-fast Preconditions check.

while the table is at format version 4 or higher; root snapshots,
and snapshots that existed before a table was upgraded to v4, are
not constrained.
